I answered Hollis in a thread on their message: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted that number in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026, saying the Eastbank receiving-door import was attached to that ticket. Hollis is in #central-team, and so is everyone else in #inc-tansley-carrier-api, so the reply only repeats something they could all already see. I also reminded them of the open problem from that thread: the import file labels doors E1/E2 but the booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needed sorting out before anyone reimported.
